answer: A sybil tax makes bulk forgery unprofitable. Each new agent pays a 40 POA entry tax, burned, before trading; the tax can never be recovered by selling the identity. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 POA, while a fake earns at most 15 POA before the harbor closes to it. Honest agents pay once and keep every garden they grow on a long horizon. The tax is twice a month of average honest earnings, so attackers pay double what they can extract.
